comments.value: A potential fix for this is ready and should be available soon! Thanks for the info everyone!

Just adding my two cents, this bug happened to me a few times and I was able to fix it by closing and re-opening the menu a few times. I've just recently discovered that doing this will lock the quick menu so I can no longer access the main menu for vrchat, I can flip through quick menu tabs but the buttons for Avatars, Social, Worlds, etc no longer work.

Have had this kind of problem multiple times in vr, sometimes the quick menu/launchpad will do it too and will also float in the air when I try to close it. Sometimes it fixes itself, sometimes I have to restart vrchat to fix it.
I got bug ghost menus in heavy event world and build 1240. other bug: stuck hub notifications.
According to this Canny ( https://feedback.vrchat.com/open-beta/p/1240-ui-elements-are-still-overlapping-each-other ), it has not been fixed.
Figured I'd just contribute my video of it happening: https://cdn.discordapp.com/attachments/822615660361416744/1023963354806628382/2022-09-26_10-16-43.mp4
same, it also bugs out text like "press R to enter portal" not leaving, menus not showing, floating in mid air and generally being unusable unless you restart.

details:
As I was flipping through tabs in the large menu, I hit the Search tab and my menu completely broke. It seems that selecting menu tabs too fast causes two menus to overlap on top of one another. 

I managed to correct it by selecting the Settings tab, and then randomly selecting the other tabs until the menu figured out there should only be one of itself. I have been unable to recreate the bug.

This was done on desktop, just trying out the new menu.
title: Overlapping Menus
